utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I... I'm not sure I can make it. Things have been a bit overwhelming lately.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Understood. We'll manage without you. Take care.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Leo. I appreciate that.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yeah, it's the one this weekend—I think there are a few projects, like appliances and park benches.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, park benches? Are you sure that's part of the repair drive? I thought it was just appliances.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, I think Oren mentioned park benches too—maybe it's both?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Oh, it's this Saturday at the community center from 10 AM to 4 PM. We're fixing broken items for neighbors. Want to help out?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Actually, it's been moved to Sunday! Still at the community center, same time.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Oh, thanks for the correction, Rosa! I'll update my schedule. Can I still help with anything specific?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: It's at my garage on 123 Oak Street.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it, 123 Oak Street. What time should I come by, and do you need any specific tools?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Starts at 9 AM sharp. As for tools, we got a good selection already, so just bring what needs fixin'.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sure, Opal! It's 42 Oak Lane.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it, 42 Oak Lane. I'll update my map. Thanks for clarifying, Mara!

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: No problem, Opal! See you tomorrow at 9.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Repair drive? I think I heard someone mention it, but I'm not sure what it is exactly.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive! It's for old appliances—I keep mixing it up with park benches. This Saturday, I think.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Old appliances, huh? I thought it was something with electronics. Well, I might swing by if I remember.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Honestly, I just got here and haven't heard much yet. What's the repair drive for?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I think it's to fix the broken benches at the park. It's this Saturday from 10 to 4.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Oh, the park benches? That sounds like a good cause. I could probably help out for a few hours.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Vik, are you coming to the repair drive on Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yes, I'll be there! It's at the park this Saturday at 9 AM near the playground. We're fixing the broken benches, so bring any tools you have!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Wait, I thought it's at the community center on Elm Street, not the park. Are you sure you have the right drive?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I hope we have enough supplies by Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Let me ask around—I know a few folks who might have extra tools or materials to spare.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That's a good idea, but can you also double-check who's actually confirmed to come? I'd hate to be short-handed.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hey Tess, I heard there's a repair drive happening? Do you know anything about it?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely! It's this Saturday from 9 to 4 at the community center on Elm Street. We've got all sorts of tools and folks to help fix things up. You should come by!

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, that sounds great! I have a broken lamp that's been gathering dust. Should I bring it along?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yes, I have a moment. The drive is Saturday at 9 AM at 123 Oak Street, right?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Actually, I'm not sure about the details. I thought it was this weekend, but Saturday at 9 AM at 123 Oak Street doesn't ring a bell. Did someone confirm that?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yes, I'm pretty sure. Eli and Rosa both told me it's Saturday at 9 AM at 123 Oak Street.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh right, the repair drive on Saturday at 9 AM. Yeah, a wrench would be great. Thanks, Gus.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I'll put a wrench aside for you, Noah. See you Saturday at 9!

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Perfect, thanks Gus. See you then.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Dane! I'm so glad you're here. I wanted to talk about our repair drive on Sunday at the community center—do you have a moment?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Rosa, I just got here — what's this repair drive all about? I haven't heard the details yet.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Sure, Dane! It's this Sunday from 10 AM to 2 PM at the community center — we're fixing small appliances and electronics for neighbors. Can I count on you to help out?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Leo, I heard something about a repair drive. What's that all about?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Repair drive Saturday morning. Bring broken stuff to my garage.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Saturday morning, got it. I'll see if I have anything to bring.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Nell, I heard you're involved with the repair drive too. Need any tools from my shed?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, that's so generous! I don't have a full list of what's needed yet, but I'm sure folks will appreciate the offer.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Well, just let me know if you think of anything. I've got wrenches, screwdrivers, even a drill if needed.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Eli, the repair drive is this Saturday at the park from 10 to 4. Are you planning to come?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Actually Ira, the drive is at my garage, 123 Oak Street, starting at 9 AM, not at the park.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, sorry for the mix-up! I must have heard wrong. I'll be at your garage on Saturday at 9.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, what repair drive? Are you sure we're talking about the same thing?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, it's to fix the school's router—this weekend, though I haven't heard the exact time or place yet.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Oh, I thought it was this Saturday at the community center, 10 to 4. You sure about the router?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I've got a box of spare parts ready for the repair drive this weekend! Are you bringing anything, Pia?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That's great, Cleo, but are we sure that's enough? I heard we're still waiting on a few things and volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, I didn't realize we were short on stuff. Let me check my list—maybe I can rustle up more from the neighbors.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Hey Sam, I got the details—it's this Saturday at the community center, 10 AM to 4 PM.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Uli, I already heard from you earlier, but I appreciate you confirming.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Oh, right, sorry—I keep forgetting what I've said.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Opal! Have you heard about the repair drive this Saturday? We're all meeting at the community center from 10 to 4 to fix stuff—bring anything that's broken!

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Oh, I already have the community center noted. Do you have any specific drop-off addresses from volunteers?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Not yet! I think everyone's just bringing their broken things directly to the center on Saturday. No need for drop-offs beforehand.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What's the schedule for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: It's this weekend! Saturday at 10 AM at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I think it starts at 9 AM, not 10.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yeah, it's at my place, 42 Cherry Lane, at 9 AM sharp!

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Wait, I thought it was at the community center on Elm Street? Did the location change?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: No, it's always been at my place, 42 Cherry Lane. Maybe you heard about a different event?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: So, the repair drive is this Saturday at 9 AM, right?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, that sounds right. Saturday at 9. I think.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Good, I'll be there. Do we need to bring anything?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Oren, do you know what exactly we're supposed to bring for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right! It's for fixing old appliances. Cleo mentioned we're low on zippers and thread, so maybe those? But I'm still not sure what I have...

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Zippers and thread? I'll check my sewing kit to see what I have. Are there other items we should consider bringing?
